verdict.rationale: Hightouch's warehouse-native design keeps customer data in the customer's own warehouse or S3 bucket rather than copying it into Hightouch. Hightouch Events also writes collected data to the customer's warehouse. Storage location therefore follows the infrastructure the customer chooses, but the evidence shows no Hightouch-side region or residency selection, and the actual region choice is made in the customer's warehouse. Missing for 10: a documented Hightouch region/residency selector (e.g., EU/US workspace hosting), first-party residency documentation, and evidence on where Hightouch's own metadata and processing reside.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: It runs on top of your data warehouse, so teams can use customer data without copying it into a separate system.
Hightouch Events collects customer behavior from websites, mobile apps, and backend systems, then stores that data in your warehouse.
Hightouch's hybrid architecture stores no data in Hightouch itself out of the box—it all stays in the customer's own warehouse/S3 bucket
